Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Modify [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   |-- Replace per-call exec commits with buffered mutations. Flush before state-dependent reads and specified canvas or metadata calls, and at script completion. Each flush creates one version, checkpoint, and undo step. Discard unflushed edits on error; retain earlier flushed batches. Immediate mode remains per-call.
  |   |   |-- Replace DiagramService create/revise calls with stored revision operations and controller publication. Preserve semantic validation, layout, and anchor reconciliation. Headless proposals use the domain controller without a live editor.
  |   |   |-- Add MappingEditorRuntime as the controller's attached editor driver. It owns tldraw shape projection and transient live geometry; settled gestures write semantic changes to controller checkpoints. Live undo follows editor history; the domain retains checkpoint history.
  |   |   `-- Retire the obsolete [D]-to-[G] create/revise connection. Preserve the checkpoint connection and reanchor its source after integration.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Mapping/tldraw runtime integration (N1)
  |       `-- Attach to the explicit MappingEditorRuntime component in [D]. Detail its controller subscription, shape projection, local anchors, input and selection coordination, gesture settlement, and history. Sources: MappingEditorRuntime.ts:1-207; MappingEditorCanvas.tsx:1-173; CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx:1-185; LocalAnchorStore.ts:1-34; shapeProjection.ts:1-54; SelectionTools.ts:1-49; NativeRoutingStore.ts:1-75.
  |
  |-- Roll-up 1 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1a] Modify its [D] Controller edits / agent access copy
  |       `-- Carry the complete buffered-exec, stored-revision, controller and attached-editor-driver corrections into this parent. Retire its obsolete create/revise connection; preserve and reanchor its checkpoint connection.
  |
  |-- Roll-up 2 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1a] Modify its [D] Controller edits / agent access copy
  |       `-- Carry the same complete corrections into this parent. Retire its obsolete create/revise connection; preserve and reanchor its checkpoint connection.
  |
  `-- Unified selection - state, gestures and WebSocket  existing canvas
      `-- [1a] Modify CanvasSession
          |-- Replace diagram/region exclusion rules with additive, deduplicated membership: whole-diagram and captured node-region selections can coexist. Canonical content-node IDs define region membership; its rectangle is a presentation envelope.
          |-- Retain captured source ASCII and revision for downstream actions, including chat. Keep panel state, focus and gesture preview separate from selection membership.
          `-- Distinguish application-owned semantic selection from native tldraw shape selection used for dragging. Cover mouse, pen and touch recognition, cancellation, settlement and synchronization without persisting transient native frames.
